title: An Interrupted Time-Series Pilot Trial of LGBTQ-Affirming Cognitive Processing Therapy for Interpersonal and Developmental Trauma
official: An Interrupted Time-Series Pilot Trial of LGBTQ-Affirming Cognitive Processing Therapy for Interpersonal and Developmental Trauma
summary: The researchers are testing a single-group cognitive-behavioral intervention for treating traumatic stress related to interpersonal and developmental trauma in LGBTQ adults. This study requires in-person participation weekly at the UAB campus in Birmingham, AL.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* LGBTQ+-identifying
* PCL-5 score ≥ 30 (clinically significant PTSD symptoms) OR verifiable PTSD diagnosis based on CAPS interview
* 18 years or older
* Documented interpersonal or developmental trauma (e.g., a history of childhood physical, emotional, or sexual abuse; sexual assault; or intimate partner violence)
* English-speaking

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prior 12-month history of non substance-induced psychosis or mania
* Non-suicidal self-injury within three months prior to screening
* Suicide attempt within 12 months prior to screening
* Illicit substance use within 7 days prior to screening
* Active diagnosis of anorexia nervosa or bulimia nervosa
* Active plan for suicide within one month prior to screening
